target_statement: Correctly type and classify the proposed exterior identity C_(a,b)=T_(a,b) A_a at a semidefinite localized completed-zeta Weil contact; run exact countermodels against every source-free version; and, independently, assume a fixed uniform zero-free strip and derive its strongest licensed consequences to decide whether it supplies any missing factorization input.
first_unproved_edge: At every semidefinite localized completed-zeta contact, the old-to-collar charge annihilates ker(A_a); equivalently, KNC/right-openness. A proof-carrying version must exhibit an inverse-free completed pole-archimedean-prime division identity rather than merely assert the equivalent kernel inclusion.
mask_or_node_class: The positive lane uses the full completed-zeta Weil distribution, including the archimedean term and all prime powers. Exact finite-dimensional and convolution-kernel models test only source-free functional-analytic claims and are never promoted to actual-zeta counterexamples.
source_data_retained: Fixed outer form Hilbert space, exact completed source, old/collar orthogonal splitting, old Euler operator, old-to-collar charge, and the distinction between an arbitrary bounded factor and an explicitly prescribed arithmetic factor.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: Complex Hilbert-space vectors under a Hermitian form. The contact hypothesis is A_a >= 0; positivity for larger support, RH, kernel triviality, or any conclusion equivalent to KNC is forbidden as a premise of the forward factorization.
normalization: Use the bounded form-operator convention A_a=I+P_a G|_(V_a) in one fixed outer Hilbert space and C_(a,b)=P_W G|_(V_a), so C_(a,b):V_a->W and C=T A typechecks. Record separately the adjoint block convention used in older reports.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: The Weil lane is a support-filtration statement. The backward strip lane fixes eta in (0,1/2] independently of height and retains the complete fixed-window R71 field and energy, not a primitive or truncated packet.
quantifier_order: Forward: for every semidefinite contact a, every b>a in the allowed collar range, every dense-core vector f, and every collar direction. Backward: assume one fixed eta works for every nontrivial zero before deriving uniform-in-block estimates as height tends to infinity.
resolution_required: Exact at a null contact. An o(1) charge, a factorization only where A_a is invertible, or a shifted-resolvent identity with parameter bounded away from zero has no contact content.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.factorization_contact_rate: exact zero charge; no asymptotic substitute
all_exponent_losses: all cutoff and completion errors must be subexponential on the licensed schedule
no complete-to-primitive or source-erasing reduction is allowed

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: Use the exact two-coordinate family A_epsilon=diag(1,epsilon), charged C(x)=x_2, and its scaled variants. It distinguishes kernel annihilation, bounded factorization, uniform factor norm, and square-root Schur control without numerical uncertainty.
downstream_socket: A valid inverse-free completed-source identity at every contact would prove KNC and therefore enters the direct RH lane. A complete R71 fixed-power saving enters the immediate uniform-strip lane. No implication between these sockets is assumed.
parallel_open_siblings: fixed-delta shifted-Psi eventual positivity or an equivalent faithful scalar detector
DPA_P(.019) and LTRAD_P(.0189,.001), currently parked absent new actual-prime structure
why_not_target_renamed: The audit must prove the factorization/kernel equivalence, identify exactly which proposed factorization statements are tautological, exhibit exact hostile models, and specify the narrower syntactic arithmetic identity class. Merely writing ker(A_a) subset ker(C_(a,b)) or T=C A_a^dagger earns no reduction credit.
abstract_convex_falsifier: Test the claimed implication on same-A/different-C finite models, on A_epsilon approaching a contact, and on a positive 2 by 2 Schur block whose cross term is only square-root small.
fejer_falsifier: Not faithful to the completed-zeta source. Its role is replaced by exact block and convolution-kernel contact models for source-free claims.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Not permitted to refute the completed-source identity. A source-preserving symbolic mismatch may refute only a precisely declared finite identity grammar.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: May replay exact prime-power and archimedean pieces of the known collar formula, but cannot certify universal contact cancellation or a strip.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: Any surviving forward proof must display a typed finite pole-gamma-prime identity valid on the dense core and through contact, with no inverse, pseudoinverse, later-support positivity, RH, or approximate remainder.
backward_fast_falsifiers: A fixed strip short of RH must not imply unshifted localized Weil positivity or KNC under the accepted interfaces.
A factorization proved only for strictly positive A_a is tautological and does not survive contact.
A shifted-resolvent factor has a pole proportional to the null charge as the shift tends to zero.
Schur positivity controls the cross term at square-root scale, whereas a uniform C=T A factor requires linear scale.
Strip plus zero counting alone does not license a quantitative localized-Weil spectral floor without the missing signed sampling estimate.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: If an admissible completed-source division identity is found, promote it as the direct-RH first-open edge. If the backward strip implies it, explicitly label the additional argument as a strip-to-RH amplifier rather than strip propagation.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: Retire all unrestricted, invertible-only, shifted-resolvent, compact/Fredholm, and Schur-positivity versions. Preserve only a formally declared completed-source identity grammar as a bounded direct-RH gamble; return primary strip effort to complete R71 or a faithful shifted detector.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact typing and equivalences are proved, each generic or disguised factorization class has an exact falsifier, the assumed-strip consequences and nonconsequences are audited, and the surviving branches are stated without claiming a strip or RH.
